# Highway Roop Precision Technologies Limited

> Highway Roop Precision Technologies Limited integrates engineering, forging, machining, aluminium die casting, tooling and validation for global automotive programmes, serving ICE and EV vehicle architectures.

## Businesses

- [Drivetrain](https://highwayroop.com/drivetrain): Forging, precision machining and assembly for engine, transmission and drivetrain applications.
- [Steering & Suspension](https://highwayroop.com/steering-suspension): Safety-critical components and assemblies with application-focused engineering and testing.
- [Lightweighting](https://highwayroop.com/lightweighting): Aluminium die casting, tooling, machining, finishing and assembly for ICE and EV architectures.
